svg.title: Professional experience
svg.desc: Concise CV-listed responsibilities and achievements for SOC Analyst at Silverspace and Junior SOC Analyst at Vizva Consultancy Services.
svg.text: 02 / CAREER
Professional experience
SOC Analyst · Silverspace
September 2025–Present · Remote
Microsoft Sentinel · Defender XDR · Entra ID · KQL · Azure Logic Apps · PowerShell
• Triaged 2,800+ alerts and escalated 140 confirmed incidents across 3,500 identities and endpoints.
• Built 22 KQL rules covering 15 MITRE ATT&CK techniques; 30 threat hunts contributed 8 new rules.
• Investigated 180 password-spray, impossible-travel, and suspicious sign-in events; supported
containment, MFA enforcement, and 90 malicious IP blocks.
• Created 9 Sentinel playbooks, saving 350 analyst hours; tuning removed 1,200 false positives and
recovered 120 analysis hours.
• Authored 45 incident reports and 12 runbooks aligned with NIST and ISO 27001.
Junior SOC Analyst · Vizva Consultancy Services
September 2021–August 2023 · India
24/7 Splunk and EDR monitoring · Phishing investigation · Escalation · Remediation
• Monitored 9,000+ events across 2,000 endpoints; analysed 650 phishing emails and their
attachments and URLs, recommending 400 domain, hash, and sender blocks.
• Escalated 220 validated incidents with timelines, IOCs, and asset context, reducing hand-off time by
3 hours per case.
• Coordinated 140 remediation tickets and verified critical fixes within 7 days.
• Created procedures adopted by 8 analysts, helping shorten onboarding to 2 weeks.
Employment details and achievements are drawn from my CV.
